description: This file defines functions for computing gradients of convolution operations (conv1d, conv2d, conv3d) with respect to inputs and weights, serving as part of the gradient interface in PyTorch's neural network module.

methods.name: conv1d_input
methods.description: Computes the gradient of conv1d with respect to the input of the convolution.

methods.name: conv1d_weight
methods.description: Computes the gradient of conv1d with respect to the weight of the convolution.

methods.name: conv2d_input
methods.description: Computes the gradient of conv2d with respect to the input of the convolution.

methods.name: conv2d_weight
methods.description: Computes the gradient of conv2d with respect to the weight of the convolution.

methods.name: conv3d_input
methods.description: Computes the gradient of conv3d with respect to the input of the convolution.

methods.name: conv3d_weight
methods.description: Computes the gradient of conv3d with respect to the weight of the convolution.
